newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil up at close on covering, technical buy.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil up at close on covering, technical buy.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market rebounded towards the close on covering and technical buying. Prices eased earlier because of soyoil's fall. Downside potential will be limited due to estimates of falls in coming months' output. Feb futures fell to 1,188 low but expect to hover at around 1,200 level.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL -Followed the futures sector, interest again confined among selected products and CPOs .
Some traders had projected a fall of between 10 and 15 percent in November output against a month ago.
End-November stocks were estimated at between 960,000 and 980,000 tonnes.
In the absence of active participation, trading volume also fell to 1,438 lots from 1,800 lots on Monday.
The physical sector saw business among nearby CPOs. Dec (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,215 ringgit after trading at 1,205 and 1,210. Bids for Dec (south) was 1,210.
